title.original: Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose: User-aware Agent Evaluation with Automated Error Analysis
title.zh: 谈话、评估、诊断：通过自动错误分析进行用户感知代理评估
title.en: Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose: User-aware Agent Evaluation with Automated Error Analysis

inclusion_reason.zh: TED 串联用户模拟、自然语言子目标评分、多指标聚合和错误诊断，是可跨域适配的 Agent 评测流水线。
inclusion_reason.en: TED connects user simulation, natural-language subgoal grading, multi-metric aggregation, and error diagnosis in an evaluation pipeline adaptable across domains.

abstract.zh: TED（Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose）以专家/非专家用户画像驱动交互，将子目标转为自然语言评分说明，并自动诊断 Agent 与 Judge 的错误。
abstract.en: TED (Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose) drives interactions with expert and novice personas, turns subgoals into natural-language grading notes, and automatically diagnoses agent and judge errors.

problem.zh: 跨领域 Agent 各自使用数据库查询或正则等成功判定，难统一扩展；忽略用户专业度也会掩盖沟通效率与中间进展。
problem.en: Domain-specific success checks such as database queries and regex do not scale uniformly, and ignoring user expertise hides communication efficiency and intermediate progress.

approach.zh: 框架复用通用用户画像模板，以 LLM Judge 对自然语言子目标说明评分，引入轮次效率和进展指标，再分析 Judge/Agent 不一致。
approach.en: Reusable persona templates interact with agents, an LLM judge scores natural-language subgoal notes, efficiency and progress metrics are added, and inconsistencies are diagnosed.

system_design.zh: TED 串联用户模拟器、Agent Harness、评分说明适配器、Judge、多指标聚合器和错误分析器，输出可行动的修复建议。
system_design.en: TED chains a user simulator, agent harness, grading-note adapter, judge, multi-metric aggregator, and error analyzer to produce actionable remedies.

key_results.zh: 框架揭示模型表现随用户专业度变化，并在把诊断修复纳入设计后提升所提效率与进展指标。
key_results.en: The framework reveals performance differences by user expertise and improves its efficiency and progress metrics after incorporating diagnosed remedies.

limitations.zh: 用户画像和 LLM Judge 都可能复制模型偏差，自然语言评分缺少确定性保证；少数领域的修复收益未必能跨域保持。
limitations.en: Personas and LLM judges may reproduce model biases, natural-language grading lacks deterministic guarantees, and remedy gains from a few domains may not transfer.

workloads: User-aware agent interaction with expert personas
User-aware agent interaction with non-expert personas

metrics.name: Peak improvement after applying diagnosed remedies

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
